senses.gloss: --a son of Bhavya of शकद्वीप. Vi. II. 4. ६०.
--a प्रजापति; husband of अदिती and father of the आदित्यस्. वा. ३०. ७२; ५०. १६८; ५२. ९५; ६७. ४३; १००. २०; १०१. ३५ and ४९.
(II)--a son of सम्राट् and उत्कला. Father of बिन्दुमती. भा. V. १५. १५.

(III)--His wife was ऊर्णा; had six sons in the first antara; then Gods laughed at ब्रह्मा seeking connec- tion with his daughter; these were born of हिरण्यकशिपु as Asuras, but were taken away by योगमाया; then they were born of देवकी and killed by Kamsa. भा. X. ८५. ४७-49.
(IV)--created from the eyes; one of the Nine ब्राह्मणस् alluded to in the पुराणस्। Br. I. 5; II. 9. १८ and २२; ११. १०; १३. ५४.

(VI)--a son of ब्रह्मा married धर्मव्रता, the daughter of Dharma whom he cursed for dereliction of duty, to become a stone; got one hundred sons through her; in turn cursed by her for the unjust curse. वा. १०७. 7, २६; ११२. ३६.
(VII)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा; married सन्नती. Vi. I. 7. 5, 7, ३७.

--a son of Danu; father of many sons number- ing ६०००, Paulomas and कालकेयस्, all residents of हिरण्य- pura and could not be killed even by the Devas, because of a special boon from ब्रह्मा; Arjuna slew them;
1: Br. III. 6. 5; M. 6. १८, २३-35.
his wives, पुलोमा and कालका, the daughters of वैश्वानर.
2: Vi. I. २१. 8-9.
(I)--the wife of Parjanya. Br. II. ११. १९; वा. २८. १६.
(II)--an Apsarasa. Br. III. 7. 6; वा. ६९. 5.
(I)--the gods of the ninth Manvantara; a गण of १२ gods. भा. VIII. १३. १९; Br. IV. 1. ५५, ५८-9; Vi. III. 2. २१. [page२-638+ २३]
(II)--the world of हविष्मन्त Pitr2s in the मार्ताण्डमण्डलम्. M. १५. १६.
(III)--the world of उपहूत Pitr2s; belonging to क्षत्रियगण. वा. ७३. ३८-9.
(IV)--sons of Meru सावर्णि. वा. १००. ५९.
--do severe austerities at Benares. M. १८३. ३१.
--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २४४.
--one of Danu's sons. वा. ६८. 5.
--a daughter of trees given by Soma as wife of Pracetasa for the generation of दक्ष. वा. ६३. ३३-7.
--a southern country. Br. II. १६. ५९.
--a daughter of a Bhoja king; wife of देवमीढ and mother of Vasudeva and others. भा. IX. २४. २७; Br. III. ७१. १४५.

(I)--a daughter of कण्डु and Pramloca (of Soma म्। प्।) (of plants and trees, शाखिन् ब्र्। प्।) brought up by trees and married to Pracetasas who were the ten sons of प्राचीनबर्हिस; mother of दक्ष: gave birth to trees, plants, and (R. चन्द्रवती (म्। प्।) In the previous birth, she was the queen of a king who died young. She became a widow with no son; prayed to the Lord who blessed her with ten righteous husbands. These were the Pracetasas and had a number of sons; she herself had a miraculous birth. भा. IV. ३०. १३ and ४७-9; Br. I. 1. १०७; II. १३. ७०; ३७. ३२-8; M. 4. ४९-50. Vi. I. १५. 8-9, ४६-50, ६१-71.
(II)--the wife of शूर and mother of Vasudeva and others. Vi. IV. १४. २६-7. [page२-693+ ३४]

(I)--the name of a desert;
1: भा. I. १०. ३५.
water in, due to ignorance.
2: वा. १०४. ३९.

(II)--the son of शिघ्रराज and father of प्रश्रुत (प्रसुश्रक-वि। प्।); having attained perfection in योग: he [page२-639+ २६] resides in कलापग्राम (still rooted in Yoga-वि। प्।): would revive the solar race at the end of Kali. भा. IX. १२. 5-7; Br. III. ६३. २१०-11. Vi. IV. 4. १०८-11.
(III)--a son of हर्यश्व and father of प्रतीपक (Pratyambaka ब्र्। प्।; Pratitvaka-वा। प्।). भा. IX. १३. १५-6; Br. III. ६४. ११. वा. ८९. ११.
(V)--of the इक्ष्वाकु line, living in कलापग्राम and endowed with Yoga. भा. XII. 2. ३७.
(VI)--a son of the III सावर्ण Manu. Br. IV. 1. ८१.
(VII)--the place sacred to ललिता. Br. IV. ४४. ९८.
(IV)--on the way from द्वारका to हास्तिन- pura. भा. X. ७१. २१.
--१३ Kings of this line ruled for २०० years with वृषलस्. वा. ९९. ३६०, ३६३.
(I)--a son of Karandhama; he had no son and regarded दुष्यन्त of Puru's family as his son. भा. IX. २३. १७.
(III)--Mitrajyoti was his daughter. Br. III. ६८. 1, 4. [page२-640+ ४५]

(I)--the son of अविक्षित्, a cakravarti and father of Dama; helped by Samvarta, he performed sacrifices; his यज्ञस् were of a high order; Indra was much pleased with सोम, and the Brahmanas with दक्षिणा; Maruts were the guards and विश्वेदेवस् were members of the सभा;
1: भा. IX. 2. २६-9.
still is sung the glory of his sacrifice in which everything was of gold; father of नरिष्यन्त.
2: Vi. IV. 1. ३१-4. Br. III. ६१. 7; 8. ३५.

(II)--a son of Karamdhama (Karamdana- वि। प्।): issueless, adopted दुष्कन्त of the Paurava line and thus Purvasu family got merged in the Paurava line. It was a result of ययाति's curse. Br. III. ७४. 2-4; वा. ९९. 2-4: Vi. IV. १६. 3-6.
(III)--a son of उशनस्, a great warrior and राजऋषि; father of Kambalabarhis. Br. III. ७०. २५: M. ४४. २४: वा. ९५. २४.

(I)--the Wind God,
: a) Br. II. १०. ४३; वा. १०१. १९४; १०६. ५९.
appointed father of भीम;
1: Br. III. ७१. १५४; M. ५०. ४९; वा. ९६. १५३.
with Agni appointed to destroy the Asuras; Soma escaped to the ocean; Indra ordered them to dry up the ocean and they refused to incure this sin; hence were cursed to be born on the earth; did so in one body as Agastya;
2: M. ६१. 3-१९.
the lord of गन्धस् or scents.
3: वा. ७०. ११.
(II)--a Pravara of the भार्गवस्. M. १९५. ३१; १९६. १९.
(II)--one of the Marut गणस्. वा. ६७. १२८. [page२-641+ ३९]

--a mind-born daughter of ब्रह्मा (a daughter of दक्ष, भा। प्। and वि। प्।) and one of the ten wives of Dharma; mother of the Maruts among whom were मरुत्वान् and Jayanta;
1: भा. VI. 6. 4 and 8: Br. III. 3. 2 and ३२: M. 5. १५. १७: १७१. ३२, ५१, ५५; २०३. 9. वा. ६६. 2: Vi. I. १५. १०५.
other names of the Maruts.
2: M. १७१. ५२-5.

--sons of मरुत्वती and Dharma;
1: M. 5. १७; ३६. 1; १३२. 3; १७१. ५१; Br. III. 3. ३२; भा. VI. 6. 8; Vi. I. १५. १०५.
for names of the गणस् of the Maruts.
2: M. १७१. ५२; २०३. 9.
[page२-642+ ३३]

--a sacrifice performed by Bharata anxious to have a son;
1: भा. IX. २०. ३५: Br. III. ६८. 2: M. ४९. २८. वा. ९९. १५३; Vi. IV. १९. 6.
performed by Marutta for ६० years to please the Maruts and get inexhaustible अन्नम् from them.
2: वा. ९३. 2-3.
--a son of सुप्रतीक (सुप्रतीप-म्।प्।) and father of सुनक्षत्र. भा. IX. १२. १२: M. २७१. 8; Vi. IV. २२. 4.

--also Marudhanva; arid tract
1: वा. ८६. ५१.
where सम्ज्ञा roamed in the guise of a mare;
2: भा. I. १०. ३५. M. ११. २६. वा. 8. ९७; ८८. ३५.
heaven became like a desert by the havoc of तारक.
3: M. १५४. ३४.
(See Maru).
--a R in भारत- वर्ष. भा. V. १९. १८.
--sacred to मुकुटेश्वरी. M. १३. ३३.
--war musical instruments. M. १४०. ४३; वा. ५४. ३७. [page२-643+ २७]

(I)--thousands of mountains on all direc- tions of मेरुमूल, full of lofty buildings; boundary limits;
1: वा. ३५. 3; ४०. 1; ४२. ७२. वा. १०१. १५७.
transgression of, punished.
2: M. २२७. १८४.

(II)--conventions of society for the welfare of the world introduced after those of वार्ता; establishment of, by kings; for breaking them, a king goes to hell. Br. II. 7. १५३; २९. ८९; ३६. १३३; IV. 2. १५९; M. २२५. १०; Vi. I. 6. ३२.
--another name for सहस्वान्. वा. ८८. २११.
--the mother of दक्ष in the चाक्षुष epoch. वा. ३०. ६१. ७४.
--belonging to the कौशिक gotra. Br. III. ६६. ७०; वा. ९१. ९८.

--next to मुक्ताशाला of ललिता--Palmyra juice is used here: nearby in a grove lives the creator: Fourteen विद्यस्, उपविद्यस् ६४ कलस् all reside here: a little away is विष्णुलोक with a १००० pillars: beyond that is शिव- loka. Br. IV. ३४. ५४. [page२-691+ २६]
--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १५.
(I)--a son of Sunda and ताडक; set up by रावण to take the form of a golden deer in order to secure सीता: killed by राम. भा. IX. १०. 5, १०; Br. III. 5. ३५-6; वा. ६२. ७२; Vi. IV. 4. ८९.
(II)--the author of a पुराण: married पुलोमा and कालका, daughters of वैश्वानर: These had १००० sons besides the fourteen who lived in हिरण्यपुर. Br. II. ३८. 5; III. 6. २६; 7. ४६४; ४७. ६०.
(I)--a देवगण. Br. III. 1. ५०.
(II)--कश्यप gotraka1ras. M. १९९. 9. [page२-692+ ३१]

--the world created with moveables and immoveables in the epoch of; he stood in waters and performed penance for ७००० years and got Surucirditi who in turn got अरिष्टनेमि; then कश्यप to whom दक्ष, gave his daughter in marriage. वा. ६५. १०९, ११८.
--the वायु पुराण equal to the Vedas. वा. 4. १२.
--of Kings whose spies enter every- where as the wind enters everything unnoticed. M. २२६. १२.
--a तीर्थ on the नर्मदा; bath in it takes one to the वायुलोक in a heavenly chariot. M. १९१. ८६-8.
--is हनुमान्, of superior भक्ति। Br. III. ३४. ३९.

--is वायु; consorts are इडा, पिङ्गला and सुषुम्णा;
1: Br. IV. ३३. ६९-70.
a पीथ sacred to ललिता.
2: Ib. IV. ४४. ९६.
--a भार्गव gotraka1ra. M. १९५. २०; १९६. ४५.

(III)--speaks of the greatness of the नर्मदा to युधिष्ठिर;
1: M. १९०. 1; १९१. ८१; १९२. 6; १९३. ६६; १९४. ४८.
came to स्यमन्तपान्चक to see कृष्ण.
2: भा. X. ८४. 4.
(V)--a disciple of Indra Pramati entrusted with a सम्हिता; his son and grandson were respectively सत्यश्रवस् and Satyahita who traditionally handed it down. वा. ६०. २७-28. [page२-695+ २६]
--the sages, descendants and sons of पीवरी and वेदशिरस्. वा. २८. 6.

--a महा Pura1n2a told by मार्कण्डेय; containing ९००० s4lokas; he who copies it and makes a gift of it in the month of कार्त्तिक attains the fruits of पुण्ड- रीक यज्ञ। भा. XII. 7. २४; १३. 5; वा. १०४. 4; Vi. III. 6. २१; M. ५३. २६-7.
--the wife of रक्ष (Rajas वा। प्।) her son was केतुमान्. Br. II. ११. ४२; वा. २८. ३७.
--an आर्षेयप्रवर. (Angiras). M. १९६. २२.

--highways and byways; दिशामार्ग, ग्राम- मार्ग, राजपथ, साखरथ्यस्, गृहरथ्यस्, uparathyas, घण्टापथ, ग्रहान्तरम्, वृत्तिमार्ग and प्राग्वम्श with their respective measurements. Avaskaram and परीवाहम् are other dispositions of open spaces.
1: वा. 7. ११८-22.
1. dik--२० dhanus in breadth. 2. ग्राम 20 dhanus in breadth. 3. सीम 10 dhanus in breadth. 4. राजपथ 10 dhanus in breadth. 5. शाखारत्यस् or streets 4 dhanus. 6. Rathyoparathyas 3 dhanus. 7. उपारथ्य rathas 2 dhanus. [page२-696+ २७] 8. जन्घापथ 4 feet 9. गृहान्तरम् (lanes) 3 feet. १०. धृतिमार्ग 6 feet and more. ११. अवस्कारपरीवार 1 ft. all round.
2: Br. II. 7. ११२-16.
--a Goddess enshrined at केदार. M. १३. ३०.

--month of, good for the gift of the अग्नि पुराण;
1: M. ५३. २९.
best for military expedition.
2: Ib. ५६. 2; ६०. ३५; २४०. 5.
--a ब्रह्मवादिन्. Br. II. ३३. १९.
--a भार्गव gotraka1ra. M. १९५. २०.
(I)--a वानर ja1ti; born of Hari and Pulaha. Br. III. 7. १७७. ३०५, ३१९; ५१. ११.
(II)--a son of जाम्बवान्. Br. III. 7. ३०३.
--a son of Sahadeva and father of श्रुतश्रवस्. भा. IX. २२. ४६.
(II)--handing over the Yajus to यज्ञवल्क्य, Brahmarateya. वा. ६१. २१.
--the solar line. M. २९०. २४.
--here is located the world of मरीचिगर्भ where live the हविष्मन्त Pitr2s. M. १५. १६.
--Bhojas called as after the city, मृत्ति- कावर. Vi. IV. १३. 7.
--a Pravara (Angiras). M. १९६. १८.
--a son of सारण. Vi. IV. १५. २१. [page२-698+ २९]
